references.text: Describes clothes that become white, which can be seen as a parallel to the transfiguration in Mark 9:3

Daniel sees a vision of a man clothed in linen, with a belt of fine gold. His body was like chrysolite, his face shone like lightning, his eyes were like flaming torches, his arms and feet gleamed like polished bronze, and his voice sounded like the roar of a multitude. This may recall the description of Jesus in Mark 9:3.
The Revelation of John contains a description of the Son of Man with shining garments, which resembles the transfiguration in Mark 9:3
